g.text: The Event Log Is Forever; the Snapshot Is Frozen at Season End
Neither table is the sorted set itself -- both exist because the sorted set is memory-only
written ONCE per season, then frozen
event_log replays into the in-memory sorted set on cold start -- it's the source of truth for "what happened."
season_snapshot answers "who won season 7" forever, even after the sorted set resets for season 8 and the old standings are gone from memory.
